blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A barangay secretary in Makati City has been preventively suspended by the Office of the Ombudsman for six months without pay over alleged unauthorized solicitation for a Christmas party last year. Bayani Galzote Olegario, the barangay secretary of Barangay Sta. Cruz in Makati City was found administratively liable “for conduct prejudicial to the best interest of the service,” the Ombudsman’s office said. In its ruling as quoted in a press release, the Ombudsman said: “Such semblance of the imprimatur of public office for a purpose not shown to be a governmental function is inconsistent with the standards of […]...
